fusions.name: Butting Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves out with both palms and your head down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Stubborn Grapple
fusions.desc: Spends 5% of your maximum health to lock onto the target, dealing 8 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and giving it a 40% chance to be [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: White-Knuckle Hold
fusions.desc: You dig your fingers in and refuse to move: you take 25% less damage for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Crag Clinger
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12 and your armour by 6%, so nothing shifts you from where you hold on.
